title: Do LLM Agents Negotiate Rationally? A Mechanism-Design Framework for Verifiable Multi-Agent Interaction over A2A/MCP
abstract: arXiv:2608.14613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern LLM-agent frameworks increasingly interoperate through standards such as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-to-tool access and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for agent delegation and negotiation. However, these protocols specify transport and discovery rather than strategic correctness and do not guarantee efficient, individually rational, or strategy-proof outcomes.   We introduce a framework that (i) encodes classical negotiation mechanisms, including alternating-offers bargaining and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves-style auctions, as constraints over A2A message schemas; (ii) provides a lightweight runtime verification and repair layer that checks messages against protocol invariants; and (iii) offers a benchmark of negotiation and allocation tasks with known optimal solutions for measuring deviations from game-theoretic predictions. translated_title: LLM代理能理性谈判吗？基于机制设计的可验证多代理交互框架（适用于A2A/MCP协议）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14613v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：现代LLM代理框架日益通过标准化协议实现互操作，例如Anthropic的模型上下文协议（MCP）用于代理到工具的访问，以及Google的Agent2Agent（A2A）协议用于代理委派和谈判。然而，这些协议仅规定了传输和发现机制，而非策略正确性，且无法保证高效、个体理性或策略免疫的结果。我们引入了一个框架，该框架：（i）将经典谈判机制（包括交替出价讨价还价和Vickrey-Clarke-Groves式拍卖）编码为A2A消息模式的约束；（ii）提供轻量级运行时验证和修复层，对照协议不变量检查消息；（iii）提供一个包含已知最优解的谈判和分配任务基准，用于衡量与博弈论预测的偏差。我们使用非结构化对话和结构化协议对多个LLM骨干模型进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出一个框架，将经典谈判机制编码为A2A/MCP协议约束，并加入运行时验证与基准测试，以评估和提升LLM代理在交互中的理性与策略正确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a framework that encodes classical negotiation mechanisms as constraints over A2A/MCP protocols, with runtime verification and benchmarks, to assess and improve the rationality and strategy-proofness of LLM agents in multi-agent interactions.
